claims.reason: S1 states the 50% limit (20% from 2025) on purchases from single-tax payers. It also states that the excess is taxed at 9%.
S5 directly states the 20% limit of the previous year's total expenses for most residents.
S1 states the limit was 50% and changes to 20% from 2025. 'Outdated' is a reasonable inference.
S4 directly states the exception for profit-tax payers with annual income up to UAH 40 million.
